Plan a 3 day trip to Jaipur for my parents
11:58 PM

Here is an easy-paced 3 day Jaipur plan for your parents, with no more than two or three stops a day and a rest after lunch.

Day 1, the old city: Start with Hawa Mahal in the morning, then City Palace and Jantar Mantar. Have lunch nearby and rest at the hotel. In the evening, stroll through Johari Bazaar for jewellery and Rajasthani sweets.
Day 2, forts: Reach Amer Fort early, before the crowds and the heat. A jeep up the slope is easier than walking. Stop for photos at Jal Mahal on the way back, rest after lunch, then watch the sunset from Nahargarh Fort.
Day 3, slow day: Visit Albert Hall Museum in the morning, then Patrika Gate for photos. Do some shopping for block prints, juttis and pottery, and finish with a Rajasthani thali dinner, or an evening at Chokhi Dhani if they enjoy folk shows.

Late October to February is the best weather, with mild days and cool nights. Book a hotel close to the old city so they walk less. Want me to look at hotels, or train and flight options from their city?
